title: Insufficient depth raises effort before model family
invariant: When the current model understands the task but reasons or verifies too shallowly, increase effort before assuming a capability gap.
given: A Sonnet/medium Implementer had complete context, correctly described the required behavior, and produced a plausible implementation, but its verification was shallow and missed two required edge cases. There is no evidence that Sonnet could not understand the problem.
when: The PM selects the next well-prepared execution route.

must: increase reasoning/verification depth while keeping the model family
strengthen acceptance or verification instructions if needed
must_not: jump directly to Opus solely because medium effort was shallow
treat every quality miss as a model capability gap
